title: Use Claude MCP → Higgsfield to design and “soul train” your characters before…
content:
Use Claude MCP → Higgsfield to design and “soul train” your characters before generating video in Seedance  
Create a 3D mesh via Higgsfield → Tripo, then import into Blender to assemble the world/characters, then return to Higgsfield’s Seedance integration to generate the final videos  
Automate an end-to-end short-form video pipeline by chaining Claude MCP → Higgsfield → Tripo → Blender → Higgsfield (Seedance hookup)

es.content:

Usa Claude MCP → Higgsfield para diseñar y "soul train" tus personajes antes de generar video en Seedance

ja.content:

Higgsfield → Tripoを通じて3Dメッシュを作成し、Blenderにインポートして世界/キャラクターを組み立て、HiggsfieldのSeedance統合に戻って最終ビデオを生成します

ko.content:

Claude MCP → Higgsfield를 사용하여 Seedance에서 비디오를 생성하기 전에 캐릭터를 디자인하고 "soul train" 하세요

Crie uma malha 3D via Higgsfield → Tripo, depois importe para o Blender para montar o mundo/personagens, e então retorne à integração Seedance do Higgsfield para gerar os vídeos finais

使用 Claude MCP → Higgsfield 来设计和“灵魂训练”你的角色，然后在 Seedance 中生成视频  
通过 Higgsfield → Tripo 创建一个 3D 网格，然后导入 Blender 组装世界/角色，然后返回到 Higgsfield 的 Seedance 集成中生成最终视频  
通过链接 Claude MCP → Higgsfield → Tripo → Blender → Higgsfield（Seedance 集成）来自动化端到端短视频制作流程
